steps.text: You can now do light activity, drive and shower. Still avoid anything that strains the puncture site, like housework or gardening, and limit stairs.
Don't lift more than 10 pounds, don't strain on the toilet, and don't let water cover the puncture site (no bath, hot tub or swimming). Showers are OK after the first 24 hours.

note: Test data only. Not clinical guidance.

unmapped.reason: The sheet counts from the procedure, which isn't an anchor. Re-anchored to discharge. At least as restrictive: the window ends a few hours later than the sheet says, and between the procedure and discharge the patient is in hospital care.
